game.title: Assassin's Creed Revelations
game.blurb: Open-world historical action-adventure set in Constantinople, with Ezio Auditore and Desmond Miles, from Ubisoft, released 2011-11-15. RAWG average playtime: 14 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Ezio's Memories: DNA Sequences 1 to 9
chapters.summary: The main story, sequence by sequence. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Desmond Sequences
chapters.summary: Five Desmond Sequences, separate from Ezio's memories.

chapters.title: Dens, Recruits and the Mediterranean
chapters.summary: Training recruits to Master Assassin, den defense, faction challenges, tax collectors and the Mediterranean Defense game.

chapters.title: Collectibles, Full Sync and Challenges
chapters.summary: Animus data fragments, books, bomb missions, the Hagia Sofia challenges, Duccio and 100% synchronization.

chapters.title: Combat, Bombs and Stunts
chapters.summary: Hidden blade kills, throwing knives, poison, smoke screens, crafting bombs and parachute stunts, including from the Galata Tower.

chapters.title: The Lost Archive (add-on, likely)
chapters.summary: A final block of ten achievements about an Animus test, an induction leap, a loop and the river Styx. The add-on name is inferred, not stated.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has the page under "Assassin's Creed: Revelations" (with a colon), at completion stage 0: only its contents page and Achievements and trophies are written, and the Walkthrough is linked but not written, so nothing was used. assassinscreed.fandom.com answers the API under the same colon title, with about 486 linked pages (much of it series navigation; it includes "The Lost Archive", "Den Defense", "Mediterranean Defense" and "Templar Tax Collector"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 201870; RAWG's first result is the expected entry (4358). None of the 48 Steam achievements is hidden. The last ten achievements (Animus test, induction leap, the loop, the river Styx) form a separate block that is probably The Lost Archive add-on named on Fandom; that link is inferred from list position, not stated. "Bully" (find and beat up Duccio) sits with the collectibles and challenges as a guess. One achievement description spells "Mediterranian"; the rule matches both spellings.
